blocks.orig: In the centre of Arusha, you can find the modern 4 Points By Sheraton. This hotel, consisting of 116 rooms in no less than 10 categories, has something for everyone. There are 2 restaurants with local and continental dishes, and a spa, swimming pool and a gym to help you lose weight after. From Sheraton, you can also easily go out to explore the city, but despite this prime location, you don’t experience the hustle and bustle of the city at all once you are inside. In the beautiful garden, there are a lot of trees and shrubs, creating a natural sound wall. The versatility of this hotel makes it an ideal accommodation to start or end your holiday.
blocks.html: The modern 4 Points By Sheraton stands in the centre of Arusha. With 116 rooms spread over as many as 10 categories, the hotel suits every kind of traveller. It has 2 restaurants serving local and continental food, plus a spa, swimming pool and gym to work it all off afterwards. Sheraton is a handy base for exploring the city, yet in spite of the central location you hardly notice the hustle and bustle of the city once you are inside. The lovely garden is full of trees and shrubs that form a natural sound barrier. Because the hotel is so versatile, it is an ideal place to begin or end your holiday.
